summary: Eastern Europe, software engineer, expertise in programming languages and computer science, strong opinions on programming paradigms (especially functional programming), interest in Haskell and OCaml, critical of mainstream programming languages (Java, C++, JavaScript), advocates for static typing, views on government surveillance and privacy, skeptical of public shaming and social justice movements, critical of "white privilege" concept, believes in the importance of empirical evidence in discussions, family background of economic struggle, engaged in discussions about ethics in technology and society.
